How to trade REVERSALS - Full Course

Reversal trading is one of the BEST ways to catch high reward trades. These trades allow you to catch entries at the START of a new trend ~ meaning you can ride out the entire moves for consistent big winners.

In this class I'll be teaching you how to catch strong reversal trades, taking you through the high timeframe analysis, entry models & trade management process. Enjoy!
